leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a reactive token state using Vue's ref() API
Configure a timer-based token rotation mechanism with setInterval
Construct a secure token generation function using cryptographic methods
Bind token expiration warnings to conditional UI rendering
Integrate token validation checks before performing API requests
Manipulate token rotation intervals based on application security requirements
Initialize a token management system with automatic refresh capabilities
Render token status indicators with appropriate visual feedback
